Marissa / Lucia —

Short update on the technical side:

- Export formats: we natively export newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) for audit logs; we can also produce CSV extracts for a subset of fields. The NDJSON export includes a timestamp, actor id, action, resource, request_id, and optional metadata blob.
- Immutability/verification: exported bundles can be accompanied by SHA-256 manifests (one hash per blob) and a signed digest for the manifest (our internal signing key). For customers who require WORM retention, we can export into a customer-owned bucket with object-lock enabled and provide step-by-step instructions.
- Redaction: PII fields are redacted by default in the admin-activity export; we can provide an opt-in schema that includes PII if a customer signs a special data processing addendum (DPA).

I’ll prepare a short technical appendix (pdf) outlining the NDJSON schema and the manifest signing flow — target: Fri 7/23 EOD. Evelyn, can you take point on the questionnaire sections about organizational policies and paste our standard responses?

-Karthik
